title: America Bought Alaska For Two Cents An Acre
description:
In 1867 the United States bought Russian America, now Alaska, for $7.2 million, about two cents an acre. Some critics called it 'Seward's Folly' or 'Seward's Icebox' and said America had acquired useless land. Nearly all Russian settlers left and Alaska stayed sparsely populated until the Klondike Gold Rush began in 1896.

Source: Wikipedia, 'Alaska Purchase'. Many Americans actually supported the purchase at the time.

What's the best bargain in history? Tell us in the comments.
